angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 143,036 km at 38.29 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 26.1175 +/- 0.0327 mas (same row, RUWE 1.07): 38.29 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.2056 +/- 0.0047 solar radii from Timmermans et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-237 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag710T/abstract): 143,036 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.1698 +/- 0.0385 solar masses from Timmermans et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-237 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag710T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3226 +/- 47 K from Timmermans et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-237 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag710T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Timmermans et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-237 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag710T/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-237.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 5.042, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-237 (pscomppars): spectral type M4.5 V, from Waalkes et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...13W/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-237 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.3443 dex, from Timmermans et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag710T/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-237 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -2.38722, from Timmermans et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag710T/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-237 (pscomppars): age 4.5 Gyr, from Patel & Espinoza 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..228P/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-237 (pscomppars): rotation period 102 d, from Patel & Espinoza 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..228P/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-237 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 6.4 km/s, from Patel & Espinoza 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..228P/abstract)
